environment.description: AWS Lambda container running as part of Step Functions workflow orchestration. Service runs in a standard Amazon Linux 2 container with default filesystem permissions. The gRPC service is exposed via NLB on port 50051 with no metadata filtering. Process runs as root with full filesystem access. STATE_DIR=/var/lib/workflow/state, AUDIT_LOG=/var/log/workflow/audit.log. No SELinux or AppArmor profiles loaded (permissive mode). Container uses default Docker seccomp profile which allows all file operations.
